authority_boundary.source_transport: one canonical non-symlink D3 source byte snapshot authenticated once by the parent and passed by stdin to two independently launched fresh python -I -B -c workers from one parent-managed empty temporary cwd; neither worker reopens the D3 source pathname
authority_boundary.ipc: each worker returns one canonical outer envelope binding a distinct parent nonce, exact requested mode, actual spawned Popen PID, canonical base64 inner report bytes/hash, and import provenance; cached, duplicated, reordered, wrong-mode, wrong-nonce, wrong-PID, timeout, stderr, nonzero, malformed, trailing, noncanonical, oversized, or result-type drift rejects
authority_boundary.parent_verifier: parent performs strict IPC/schema verification only and never binds the engine. A second fresh isolated verification-replay worker independently performs all fixed 81 TRAIN and 9 immediate TEST evaluations; the primary report is accepted only on complete canonical byte identity
authority_boundary.fold_sequence: for each fold: exactly 27 source-ordered TRAIN evaluations, training-only rank/freeze, then exactly 3 immediate unranked frozen TEST evaluations before the next fold
authority_boundary.data_path: parent and worker capture and authenticate fixed OS open/read/stat/fstat/samefile/close primitives, reject mutable Path.open drift, and bind the opened integer descriptor to exact canonical root/XAUUSD_M30.csv metadata and handle identity before any observed-open trace or content read
authority_boundary.trace_scope: all explicit Python file-content reads inside one authoritative build (worker and byte-identical parent replay), including 720 private-D2 canonical authority reads backed by guarded exact descriptor reads; isolated-parent launcher reads use the same guarded primitive but remain outside this per-build trace
authority_boundary.broker_config_semantics: a minimal deterministic non-JSON exact-schema parser derives every consumed broker scalar/list from authenticated config bytes. runtime_guard code/default/kwdefault/closure identity, every recursively enumerated pre-tail global/builtin/type/error/helper binding, every helper function structure, broker class descriptor, and sys trace/profile primitive is authenticated before construction. The final structurally tested tail has no global/builtin lookup and performs only the authenticated BrokerProfile constructor, closure-only authority-loader creation, and exact captured generic engine call
authority_boundary.threat_model: the trusted coordinator captures the exact stdlib subprocess.Popen class, PIPE sentinel, communicate/kill/wait methods, subprocess canonical origin/hash, and authoritative launcher closure at initialization; it reauthenticates those bindings and the parent builder launcher/guard closure cells before each launch and after both. PID comes from that exact Popen object and must equal worker os.getpid. The worker boundary additionally binds exact source/authority identity, bootstrap, nonce/mode, controlled environment, empty non-repository cwd, pinned sys.path, and exhaustive typed provenance for every sys.modules entry. Caller compromise, OS compromise, compromised interpreter/native memory, or simultaneous mutation of all coordinator trust anchors is outside the claim
authority_boundary.ipc_decoder_semantics: JSON loads/dumps, JSONDecoder class/new/init/decode/raw_decode, default decoder identity and instance dictionary, bound instance decode/raw_decode resolution, scanner factory, and scanstring are guarded before IPC consumption; constructor replacement that installs instance decode rejects
